purpose: Define each AIGMos runtime installation/instance as an explicit stable logical identity independent from hostname, filesystem path, active snapshot and listener bindings.

value.identity_rule: Each AIGMos instance has an explicit stable canonical/logical identity.
value.name_rule: Human-facing instance name is editable descriptive metadata and does not replace instance identity.
value.path_rule: Install path/config path is implementation binding, not semantic identity.
value.host_rule: Hostname/IP/device identity does not automatically become AIGMos instance identity.
value.snapshot_rule: Runtime active snapshot is a separate binding from instance identity.
value.listener_rule: Named network listeners belong to the instance but ports/endpoints do not define the instance.
value.authority_rule: Instance existence/ownership metadata does not itself grant AccessCore rights.
